nodes.label: The Neon Audio Deck Theme
nodes.rationale: Visual theme styled after cyberpunk decks and tactical gear. Features space black bases (#0A0A0E), oklch-based neon cyan accents (#00FFCC) for connection/active status, and neon pink (#FF3366) for errors/stop states. Uses border outlines to convey depth instead of shadows.

nodes.label: 15% Accent Rule
nodes.rationale: Strict styling constraint where neon colors occupy <=15% of the total screen space. Ensures active states, visualizers, and errors have high visual contrast and do not overwhelm the dark cyberpunk theme.
